decisions.reason: As a newly launched core plastic-packaging product with its own webpage and likely meaningful tooling and commercial investment, management would tend to continue backing it and explain any weak early uptake as temporary.

Because the valve is a closely related add-on to the firm's packaging business and was given its own page, the firm is likely to justify and protect the launch rather than reverse course after only about a year.

Although the take-back service appears less visibly committed than the physical products, it still supports a strategic circular-packaging position, so management would usually retain it unless problems became unmistakable.
